title: Neural unification into a self is a pivot of earlier morphogenetic cell communication

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Neural unification into a self is a pivot of earlier morphogenetic cell communication

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: It has been hypothesized, and the authors adopt, that the ability of neurons to unify into a centralized self is an evolutionary pivot of earlier cell-communication strategies that first solved problems in anatomical morphospace, a domain also requiring information processing above the single-cell level.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Collective intelligence: A unifying concept for integrating biology across scales and substrates

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: McMillen P 2024, Collective intelligence: A unifying concept for integrating biology across scales and substrates › Introduction

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Indeed it has been hypothesized that the remarkable ability of neurons to unify toward a centralized self – the emergent agent that is the subject of memories, preferences, and goals which are not assignable to any of the individual components – is an evolutionary pivot of far earlier cell communication strategies that first solved problems in navigating another domain that requires information processing above the single cell level: anatomical morphospace70.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: McMillen P, Levin M, “Collective intelligence: A unifying concept for integrating biology across scales and substrates”, Communications biology (2024), doi:10.1038/s42003-024-06037-4; section “Introduction”. Scope: Evolution of nervous systems from non-neural bioelectric signalling in metazoans

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-collective-02: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.39

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Comparative genomics and signaling data can test specific components of an evolutionary pivot. They do not uniquely resolve the claimed transition to a unified self.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Compare phylogenetic timing, molecular homology, and dynamical functions of non-neural morphogenetic communication with neural integration, testing explicit co-option models against independent-origin models.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Centralized self and anatomical problem-solving lack unique biological readouts.

Deep evolutionary histories permit several equivalent co-option narratives.

data adequacy: 0.26

analysis feasibility: 0.48
data existence: 0.52

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Public genomes can test the only sharply dated piece of the hypothesis: whether bioelectric components predate neurons. That analysis is standard and already feasible. It leaves the claim that neural unification into a self is an evolutionary pivot of morphogenetic problem-solving unmeasured, because component age does not establish homology of function.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Date voltage-gated channels, gap-junction proteins and neurotransmitter machinery on metazoan and pre-metazoan genomes, and ask whether those families are present in non-neural lineages before the origin of neurons. Presence before neurons would support reuse of older components; restriction of the families to animals with nervous systems would weaken the temporal-order proxy. Neither result measures whether a neural self is a functional pivot of morphogenetic control.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Ancient shared components are compatible with co-option, convergence or unrelated reuse.

A centralized self, memories and goals are not variables in genome databases.

Gene presence is not evidence that the proteins controlled anatomy before they controlled behavior.
